summary.text: Jay Fisher is a Republican state representative from North Dakota who has represented House District 5 since December 2018 and is the Republican candidate for North Dakota State Senate District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Fisher assumed office in the North Dakota House of Representatives on December 1, 2018.
Ballotpedia lists him on the House Finance and Taxation Committee and the House Agriculture Committee for 2023-2024.
He is not running for re-election to the House in 2026, and he advanced from the Republican primary for the Senate seat on June 9, 2026.
